component.name: Companion
component.summary: Official multi-platform configuration tool for OpenIPC cameras

description.p: Companion is an official multi-platform configuration tool for OpenIPC cameras, built with Avalonia UI. The app manages camera settings, telemetry, presets, and firmware updates.

ul.li: Camera settings management: configure resolution, frame rate, and exposure
Telemetry: view real-time metrics like temperature, voltage, and signal strength
Setup wizards: guided setup for device and network configuration
Multi-platform support: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS targets
YAML-based configuration files: edit and customize settings with YAML
